assessment: Five-year test: the thesis passes. The outward-steadiness discriminator and the loyalty argument rest on dated first-person evidence from 2021 to 2025: Interview/Knightley 2021, Elle 2022, i-D 2023, Vanity Fair and Interview/Portman 2024, and Harper's Bazaar UK 2025. Removing all 2026 material (Werwulf, the Empire quote, Alpha Gang) leaves the argument intact. The draft handles dates well in most places. The election is dated to November 2024, the age is stated 'as of October 2026', the Idol timeline uses absolute dates, and the current relationship was deliberately left out (C09 removed), which is the right durability call. Correctly not an open case: she has been public since 2014 and has a deep interview record. The weak spots are maintenance surfaces. The closing section is built on a film releasing December 25, 2026, written in future tense (major). Several open-ended status or absence claims lack an as-of bound or a trigger: Chanel 'since 2015', 'since 2021', 'nobody has described', 'two biggest roles' in the description, and the site's own typing of Johnny Depp. The load-bearing Levinson relationship has no review trigger. I verified the absolute dates against Wikipedia raw text on 2026-10-16: Werwulf US December 25, 2026 and UK January 1, 2027; Alpha Gang Telluride premiere September 5, 2026, with no distributor listed. The Johnny Depp draft still reads enneagram: 4. Similarity advisory did not trip (max 0.174 vs Arthur-Mensch, the generic 'read of public record' disclaimer); after comparing the arguments, I found no meaningful reuse. One aside outside this role: the 'ready to see me fail' block quote ('By 2024 she described the scrutiny as fuel.') names no outlet; it is Vanity Fair, November 2024 (S07).
